Jenny-authored write + edit diff metadata reload scenario for Phase 4. One assistant turn that runs `write_file` then `edit_file` against the same path, each `tool_result` carrying a small bounded `metadata.diff` payload (additions / deletions / hunks). Pins tool-step row coalescing for the agentic-coding write+edit sequence the code-review rail surfaces.

Note: the message-form tree projector does not propagate `tool_result.metadata` into projected `event.payload.metadata` — diff metadata is preserved on the persistence path (`services/backend/chat-stream-tool-handling.js` → `turn_events[]`) and on the row projector when persisted turn_events already carry it. Those paths are covered by `tests/renderer-turn-reducer.test.js`, `tests/renderer-turn-row-projector.test.js`, and `tests/chat-stream-tool-handling.test.js`. This fixture pins the message-form projection of write+edit turns; expected-rows.json reflects the message-form drop and does not assert payload.metadata on rows.
